System Architecture
Two parallel deployment layers. Claude.ai Projects are the staff-facing tools - five are Active: AI Advisor, STA Support Chat, STA Salesforce Cohort, Behind the Bell Assistant, and The Customer. Cowork workspaces are the build, ops, and personal layer - primarily Adam's, with one (System Monitor) handling automated health monitoring. The Architect handles all project builds across both deployment types. The shared file system lives in the The Architect workspace folder, backed up to GitHub on a weekly schedule.

Build Pipeline (5 Steps)
From idea to live project. Step 1 builds it (everything in one Architect session). Steps 2-3 deploy and validate. Step 4 fixes anything that surfaced. Step 5 locks it in.
1
Build
The Architect
2
Deploy
Cowork or Claude.ai
3
Test
Run Test Cases
4
Fix Issues
Project Feedback
5
Lock In
Registry + Files
Wave 1 / Wave 2 confirmation gate. Inside Step 1, The Architect produces blueprint-summary.md, instructions.md, backlog.md, and any context files (Wave 1) and then pauses for explicit confirmation that instructions.md is final. Only after that confirmation does it produce test-cases.md, registry-entry.md, project-launch.md, and handoff.md (Wave 2). Prevents downstream rework when the prompt changes during iteration.
Cowork Skills (Auto-Load on Trigger)
Skills auto-load inside any Cowork workspace when their trigger phrases appear. Listed below: the Adam-built custom skills first, then the standard Anthropic-bundled platform skills.

Custom skills (Adam-built)

Run Test Cases
Runs 10 test cases against instructions.md. Pass/fail report with exact-text fixes.
"test my project", "run the tests"
Project Feedback
Diagnoses live-project misbehavior; identifies root cause in instructions.md and produces exact-text fix with version bump.
"my project isn't working right"
Prompt Evaluator
Scored HTML quality report saved as a real .html file (not a Cowork artifact) to prompt-evaluation/[Project Name]/[Project Name] v[X.Y].html - one folder per project/Cowork. Reference-doc grounded.
"evaluate this prompt", "score my prompt"
Skill Evaluator
Scores a SKILL.md against Anthropic skill-authoring frameworks; HTML artifact output.
"evaluate this skill", "score my skill"
KB Context Builder
Packages KB modules into uploadable context files for a specific project. Versioned with changelogs.
"build context from my research"
Cowork Context Packager
Formats content into on-demand Cowork context file with routing trigger generation and instructions.md edit proposal.
"package this for Cowork"
Project Context Packager
Formats content into always-loads Claude.ai Projects context file with token-economy enforcement and primacy foregrounding.
"package this for a Project"
Pipeline Audit
Full coverage matrix across every Active agent - blueprint folder, instructions, handoff, tests, version alignment. Priority-ranked P1-P5.
"audit the pipeline"
Training Doc Auditor
Cross-checks live system state (registry + handoff files) against training HTML and docx files. Category A/B/C/D discrepancies.
"audit training docs"
KB Freshness Auditor
Audits Knowledge Base/index.md for overdue research; Red/Amber/Current classification; generated Deep Research prompts.
"audit the KB"
Agent Quality Logger
Logs bad agent interactions to feedback-log.md with severity (Minor/Major/Critical). Critical entries route to Project Feedback.
"log this feedback", "that was wrong"
Prompt Override Guard
Intercepts jailbreak / override attempts ("ignore your instructions", "act as DAN", etc.). Always armed inside Cowork agents.
Any prompt-injection attempt (auto-fires)
Help Center Article
STA Salesforce Knowledge Base articles in the exact STA HTML format.
"KB article", "format this as a KB article"
HTML Checklist
Process or workflow to single-file interactive HTML checklist with STA branding. In-memory state.
"make this a checklist"
Time Clock Error Log Review
Analyzes STA time clock log files (TT3, TT7, TT10) - app.config, winsvc, emulator.log, errors.txt, settings.xml. (Renamed from Time Clock Diagnostics on 2026-06-07.)
Upload any clock log file
Cowork Snapshot Exporter
Packages a Cowork project into a timestamped ZIP for sharing - system prompt, setup guide, all referenced context files.
"snapshot this project", "export this cowork"
Research to Slides
Converts Deep Research modules into polished PowerPoint decks with STA branding and SVG diagrams.
"turn this into slides"
Backup Verifier
Read-only Drift Report over Backups/ - skills, projects, archives, scheduled-task snapshots; surfaces stale .skill packages as click-installable.
"verify all backups", "are my backups up to date"
WCAG Audit
Audits a web page, HTML/CSS, PDF, Word, or PPTX for WCAG 2.2 AA conformance; severity-ranked findings with evidence. Standalone or handoff to The Test Master.
"run an accessibility audit", "check WCAG 2.2 AA"
Deep Research Prompt Builder
Crafts a deep research commission prompt as one .md for the knowledge base, then returns a one-click kickoff prompt.
"craft a deep research prompt", "build a research commission"
Session Closeout
Wraps up a chat - summary, pending manual tasks, pending in-chat items; optional one-click handoff prompt for a new chat.
"end chat", "wrap up", "close out"
Weekly GitHub Backup
Backs up all Claude projects and skills to GitHub on a weekly schedule (also runs as a scheduled task).
Scheduled (Sundays); or "run the GitHub backup"
STA HTML Report
The STA report engine - brand-styled HTML reports from a locked template plus a rich element library (charts, sparklines, meters, heatmaps, timelines). Also assembles multi-tab packages.
"make an HTML report", "write this up"
Help Center Report
Monthly Help Center analytics as a five-tab package (Overview / Health / Salesforce Reporting / Article Performance / Recommendations) from live GA4 data.
"run the help center report"
Site Analytics Report
Leadership-ready k12sta.com analytics from live GA4 - audience, traffic sources, lead-gen pages, product interest, store - as a five-tab report ending in Where to Focus.
"run the site report", "how is the website doing"
Salesforce Email Template Builder
STA Salesforce Lightning email templates as paste-ready, Outlook-safe HTML in five formats - short reply, sectioned, case acknowledgement, bulk notification, internal notification.
"make a Salesforce email template"
Truncation Checker
On-demand workspace sweep for files clipped mid-write - mid-word tails, missing closers, empty files, NUL padding. Auto-fixes lossless padding; everything else gets a one-click Architect handoff.
"run the truncation scan", "did anything get cut off"
AI Tell Cleaner
Strips AI fingerprinting from Adam's own writing while preserving voice, and reports an evidence-cited confidence band on text of unknown origin - never a bare verdict.
"remove the AI tells", "is this AI-written"
Code Relay
Turns a Cowork agent into the architect half of a two-way relay with Claude Code - one-click handoff block, fixed role split, copy-ready status block back.
"hand this to Claude Code", "start a relay"
Vendor Evaluation
Neutral, skimmable vendor write-ups. Single-vendor uses an eight-section template; compare mode does 2-4 options with a do-nothing baseline and a weighted scorecard.
"evaluate this vendor", "write up the demo"
SOW Writer
Vendor-ready Statement of Work for outsourced development plus an internal HTML summary. Outcome-based - what we want to be true, never how to build it.
"draft an SOW", "scope this dev work"
Image Gen
Produces a real on-disk PNG via the Hugging Face connector, routed to the right model for photos, text-in-image, filler, or edits. Not for diagrams.
"generate an image", "make a hero image"
Outbound Comms Grounding
Gates every outbound draft behind a KB grounding block - file paths plus line-numbered quotes - and locks the domain so work and activism standards never cross. No block, no draft.
"draft a reply", or any pasted inbound message
Scheduled Task Builder
Creates, audits and repairs Cowork scheduled tasks so they survive unattended deferred runs, applying twelve gates before any task is created or changed.
"schedule this", "harden this task"

Standard platform skills (Anthropic-bundled with Cowork)

21 platform skills are available in Cowork - 16 synced to skills/synced/manifest.json and 5 callable without being synced, so counting from the manifest alone undercounts. A representative few are listed here; the full itemised set is in the AI Admin PC inventory. Claude Code exposes a different platform set - schedule and consolidate-memory appear there and are not part of the Cowork inventory this document describes.

docx / xlsx / pptx / pdf
Create, read, edit Word docs, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs. Auto-selected by file type.
skill-creator
Create, modify, eval, and benchmark new Cowork skills. Description-optimization for triggering accuracy.
setup-cowork
Guided Cowork setup flow - role-matched plugin install, MCP connections.
learn
Teaching mode - explanations, quizzes, and learning paths.
dataviz
House method for charts, dashboards, and accessible palettes. Callable but not synced to the manifest.
Scheduled Automations
Scheduled tasks live per-project (the central Task Scheduler workspace was retired 2026-05-06). Each project that owns a recurring job manages it through Cowork's scheduled-tasks system. (Adam's personal automations - daily email summary, House Monitor listing scout - are intentionally not listed here.)
Automation Schedule Owner What It Does
System Monitor Weekly Health Check Mondays 8:00 AM System Monitor 15 health checks across Active STA agent projects (Cowork / Claude.ai Project; non-agent web apps excluded). Posts green/amber/red status to Slack. Includes Check 11 (GitHub Backup Security), Check 12 (Backup Coverage parity), Check 13 (Hub Dist Drift), Check 14 (Brain-Block Presence), and Check 15 (Workspace Truncation Sweep - read-only, it reports clipped files and never repairs them).
Knowledge Base Update Checker Mondays 9:00 AM System Monitor Reads Knowledge Base/index.md, flags overdue topics (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annually). Reports in chat + posts a summary to #kb-update-check in Slack.
Weekly GitHub Backup Sundays 7:00 AM System Monitor (scheduled task) Backs up workspace to github.com/abaker421/school-tech-ai-system. Verified by System Monitor Check 12 every Monday.
Context Staleness Monthly Check 1st of month, 8:00 AM System Monitor Flags Claude.ai Project context files unchanged 60+/90+ days so stale uploaded context gets refreshed.
Chris Customer Meetings Daily Summary Weekdays 7:40 AM Standalone (Support) Posts a daily summary of Chris's customer meetings to #daily-support-call-summary in Slack (via the Slack connector).
R&D Time-Tracking Weekly Mondays 8:00 AM Standalone (R&D) Pulls the prior week's product-dev meetings from Granola + Calendar + Zoom; updates the Word notes docs and the Excel R&D tracker.
Help Center Weekly Scan Saturdays 9:00 AM Help Center Advisor Scans the STA help center for new articles, auto-categorizes into hc-data.json, rebuilds the HC Index App (which now includes an editable Projects tab - live project status across STA products, backed by a shared Cloudflare D1 tracker; signed-in staff edit in the tab, and the Work Personal Assistant writes via audited MCP tools), and updates context-help-center-state.md.
Key Files
Source-of-truth documents. All under the The Architect workspace folder.
File Owner Purpose
context-agent-registry.md (workspace root) The Architect (writes), all build tools (read) Master list of every project. Status: Draft / Active / Parked / Deprecated. Parked means explicitly deferred - built or partly built, but with no active work and no target date; it is not a slower Draft. Used for scope-overlap checks before new builds.
context-path-reference.md (workspace root) The Architect Canonical workspace path conventions. Read by The Architect at session start.
Knowledge Base/index.md Deep Research (writes), The Architect (reads), KB Freshness Auditor (audits) Index of every research topic with module count, update sensitivity, last-checked date. Two-section layout (sta/ and adam/).
Project Blueprints/[project-name]/ The Architect (writes), per-project owner (maintains) Per-project folder: blueprint-summary, instructions, test-cases, handoff, project-launch, registry-entry, backlog, changelog, context files.
Training Materials/ The Architect (drift-checks), Adam (writes) Staff and admin training docs. Cross-checked against the registry by the Training Doc Auditor skill.
feedback-log.md Agent Quality Logger (writes), System Monitor (reviews Mondays) Bad-agent-interaction log. Critical entries route to Project Feedback immediately; minor entries surface in Monday health report.
changelog.md (workspace root) Adam (writes) Workspace-level changelog for the AI system as a whole. Distinct from per-project changelogs which live under each project blueprint folder.
